correctness.rationale: The length-two language is exactly {00,01,02,10,20}. Every length-1706 factor of the infinite fixed point lies in a pair of neighboring level-14 substitution blocks, and each such block pair occurs. Therefore the all-position three-shift criterion is equivalent to an explicit finite factor test. Exact enumeration over all 3413 factors by exhaustive first/second-shift pairs and bitset intersections produces every permissible third shift once, yielding 145217 rows. Independent direct-prefix factors and a separately implemented full 145217-row recomputation agree. No finite sample is being substituted for the factor-boundary theorem.

value.rationale: An explicit literature problem asks for the three-pseudoperiods of the Tribonacci word. The full 145217-element set up to a canonical substitution length of 1705, with exact counts at ten characteristic length boundaries and a reproducible complete exclusion/enumeration certificate, is a motivated substantial finite cutoff and useful initial language for testing prospective automata, rather than an arbitrary small example.
